synopsis: Haider et al. built a tool-independent, ray-traced lidar model incorporating the scan pattern and full signal-processing chain, packaged as an ASAM OSI/FMI unit [f4504]. Chapter 6 dates validation at both time-domain and point-cloud levels to October 2022, and the rain and fog extension using Mie-theory backscatter to August 2023 [f4505, f4506]. Chapter 10 identifies a peer-reviewed rain and fog model published in Sensors 23(15):6891 in August 2023, also validated at time-domain and point-cloud levels [f7819]. All cited validation evidence is on-road; these facts do not establish validation for heavy off-road machines or clarify whether the October 2022 validation covered the later weather extension [f4505, f4506, f7819].

relations.note: Both report time-domain and point-cloud validation using on-road evidence.
